newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Borg-Warner Auto started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Borg-Warner Auto started.

text.p: --Mesirow Financial said Monday it initiated coverage of Borg-Warner Automotive Inc with a focus buy rating.

--Mesirow said the automotive systems supplier has a competitive edge from investing heavily in research and development and production facilities, and from focusing on quality. Acquisitions and growth in demand for its core products are driving earnings and revenue growth, it said.

--Mesirow said it expects Borg-Warner to earn $3.25 a share in 1996 on revenues of more than $1.5 billion, compared with $3.15 a share and revenues of $1.3 billion in 1995. For 1997, Mesirow sees Borg-Warner earning $4.32 a share on revenues of $1.7 billion.
--Mesirow said it gave Borg-Warner a 12-month price target of $50 a share.
